content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:** the performance exit no longer hangs on an undefined, contingent instrument. It is now anchored directly in Array's own obligations under this Agreement — "if Array fails to meet its supply obligations under Article 9 of this Agreement, including any service levels or delivery dates agreed by the Parties or set forth in any supply agreement entered into pursuant to Article 9" — so the automatic termination of Ono's covenant operates whether or not a separate supply agreement is ever executed, while still capturing service levels and delivery dates in any such agreement.

**Unchanged and confirmed:**
- 12-month cap ("in no event continue beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date") reaches every Ono obligation in Section 8.2, including the post-termination tail.
- Defined product category is already met by the retained "Competing Product" definition (already_met, quoted from p0492).
- Array's mirror covenant and the Array-Commercializes royalty-termination mechanic are untouched; the sole collateral edit conforms Array's termination trigger to the cap and preserves the Article XIV reference to Section 8.2.
- Article IX raises no second exclusivity: Section 9.4(a) leaves Ono free to Manufacture or engage a Subcontractor.

I did not add a cure period or failure-standard gloss, as no selected checklist element requires it.
